title: Salty Hounds
description:
WELCOME TO SALTY HOUNDS!SALTY HOUNDS is an open-world dating sim in which you will create your own love story.

(*Please find the streaming guide at the bottom)

LOVE INTERESTSThe love interests have their own daily schedules, preferences and secrets that wait to be unraveled.

 

GAMEPLAYAfter your father's accident, you take charge of Salty Hounds, a small bodyguard agency. Meet your love interests and win their hearts through many daily encounters, special events and romantic dates. Enjoy a romantic life in a living and breathing open-world city featuring a fully realized night / day cycle.

 

Find the love interests, talk to them, learn about them and build up your relationship over time. As you make friends with them and gain their trust, you will unlock new events and romantic dialogues.

 

• An immersive world and smoothly animated characters in high-quality pixel art

• Many beautiful hand-painted illustrations and character artworks

• Many voiced contents (more will be added), recorded by famous Korean VAs

• Dynamic dialogues with the NPCs that change with your affection level and other stats

• Enjoy random encounters throughout the city and activities to raise your skills 

Your Lovers

Fall in love with five unique characters, each with their own charm! 

♥ Noru, the Chief Bodyguard 

"I don't remember us ever being that close."An aloof loner that borders on unsociable, but an excellent bodyguard in the field. Despite being a childhood friend of yours, he doesn't seem comfortable with you around. 

♥ Seha, the Head of a Rival Company 

"Is that really the sorta thing you should be asking your 'rival'?"The young but capable head of the rival company, 'Haeryang Securities'. Both gentle and ruthless at will, he is a foe to be reckoned with. 

♥ Taemin, the Cheerful Bodyguard "What? Triple overtime pay? Be there in a second!" A playful and suave bodyguard with soft but powerful leadership. You've come to accept his free spirit, but with that he'd at least wear a tie to work. 

♥ Yujin, the Crime Investigator "Now is the time to exercise your right to remain silent."A capable crime investigator, set out to create a world without injustice. He used to give you private lessons, but that was a long time ago. 

♥ Junho, the Gullible Bodyguard "Really? You don't deduct hot water from my paycheck?"A gullible bodyguard working for a shady security agency, getting ripped off on a daily basis. Maybe you should help him out? 

STREAMING GUIDE: • To prevent story spoilers, we'd like to ask you to limit streams to content up to Affection LV 1 ~ 2 for each character!

• Kindly include 'Early Access' in your title and a link to our Steam page.
description_short: A unique dating sim adventure that gives you total freedom to romance five handsome guys in an open-world metropolis.
